name: ocean-creatures
inputText:
Blue Whale — largest animal ever lived, up to 100 feet long, heart the size of a car, tongue weighs as much as an elephant
Great White Shark — apex predator, can detect one drop of blood in 25 gallons of water, 300 serrated teeth in rows
Octopus — eight arms with suckers, three hearts, blue blood, can change color and texture instantly, extremely intelligent
Jellyfish — no brain, no heart, no blood, 95% water, some are immortal (Turritopsis), tentacles deliver painful stings
Sea Turtle — can live over 100 years, migrates thousands of miles, returns to the same beach where it was born to lay eggs
Anglerfish — deep sea predator, female has a glowing lure on its head to attract prey in total darkness, males are tiny parasites

rooms.name: Titan Blue Cathedral
rooms.itemToRemember: Blue Whale — largest animal ever lived, up to 100 feet long, heart the size of a car, tongue weighs as much as an elephant
rooms.mnemonic: The biggest animal that ever lived — longer than a basketball court, with a heart so huge you could crawl through its arteries, and a tongue that weighs as much as an entire elephant.
rooms.sceneDescription: An enormous Blue Whale glides through deep crystal-clear ocean water, its massive 100-foot body dominating the entire frame. The whale is seen from slightly below and to the side, emphasizing its staggering size. Its blue-gray mottled skin has a beautiful marbled pattern. Sunlight streams down from the surface above in golden shafts, illuminating the whale's massive body. The whale's eye is visible — small relative to its body but intelligent and gentle. Its enormous mouth shows baleen plates along the jaw. A scuba diver is visible far below for scale, appearing tiny like an ant next to the whale. Deep blue water fades to darkness below and glows turquoise above. Schools of small fish scatter around the whale. Photorealistic, underwater, cinematic wide-angle, dramatic light rays.

odysseyKeyframes.prompt: Enormous Blue Whale gliding through crystal-clear ocean, 100-foot body dominating frame. Seen from below, blue-gray mottled skin. Golden sunlight shafts from surface. Gentle eye visible. Baleen plates. Tiny scuba diver for scale. Deep blue water. Fish scatter. Photorealistic, underwater, cinematic.

The Blue Whale's enormous tail flukes rise slowly and sweep downward in a powerful stroke, propelling the 100-foot body forward. The water displacement creates swirling currents. Sunlight ripples across its massive blue-gray back. Bubbles stream from its body. The sheer mass moving through water is awe-inspiring.

The Blue Whale opens its enormous mouth wide, revealing rows of baleen plates as it engulfs a massive cloud of krill. Its throat expands like an accordion with hundreds of ventral grooves stretching. Water and krill rush into the cavernous mouth. The scale is overwhelming — the open mouth could swallow a car.

interactionButtons.label: Tail splash!
interactionButtons.prompt: The Blue Whale's enormous tail flukes are sweeping downward in a powerful stroke, displacing a massive wall of water, swirling currents and bubbles spiraling outward from the 100-foot body, golden sunlight shafts rippling across its blue-gray mottled back, the sheer force of the movement visible in the churning ocean

interactionButtons.label: Open wide!
interactionButtons.prompt: The Blue Whale is opening its enormous mouth impossibly wide, revealing rows of baleen plates as it engulfs a massive shimmering cloud of krill, its accordion-like throat grooves stretching and expanding, water and krill rushing into the cavernous mouth that could swallow a car, sunlight illuminating the interior

interactionButtons.label: Swim beside it
interactionButtons.prompt: The Blue Whale is gliding peacefully through crystal-clear water directly past the viewer, its 100-foot body stretching endlessly from nose to tail, the gentle intelligent eye looking sideways at the camera, sunlight streaming across its beautiful mottled blue-gray skin, a tiny scuba diver visible far below for scale

rooms.name: Razor Tooth Patrol
rooms.itemToRemember: Great White Shark — apex predator, can detect one drop of blood in 25 gallons of water, 300 serrated teeth in rows
rooms.mnemonic: The ocean's ultimate hunter with 300 razor-sharp teeth lined up in conveyor-belt rows — and a nose so sensitive it can smell a single drop of blood mixed into a swimming pool.
rooms.sceneDescription: A Great White Shark powers through clear blue ocean water directly toward the camera, its mouth partially open revealing rows upon rows of razor-sharp serrated teeth — 300 teeth arranged in multiple rows, the front teeth large and triangular, with replacement rows behind. The shark's body is massive and streamlined — dark gray-blue on top, stark white underneath. Its black eye is cold and focused. Sunlight from above creates dramatic lighting on its skin, highlighting every scar and scratch. The snout has visible electroreceptor pores (ampullae of Lorenzini). Bubbles and small fish scatter away from its path. The water is crystal clear blue-green. Power, speed, and predatory focus radiate from the image. Photorealistic, dramatic front-angle, underwater, cinematic.

odysseyKeyframes.prompt: Great White Shark powering through clear blue water directly toward camera. Mouth open showing rows of 300 serrated teeth. Dark gray-blue back, white belly. Cold black eye. Sunlight on scarred skin. Electroreceptor pores on snout. Fish scatter. Photorealistic, dramatic, underwater, cinematic.

The Great White Shark turns sharply, its powerful body twisting through the water. Its rows of teeth flash in the sunlight. The muscular tail propels it with explosive speed. Water churns in its wake. Small fish flee in panic. The shark's predatory agility is terrifying.

The Great White lunges upward with explosive force, breaching the surface. Its massive body launches partially out of the water, jaws wide open, 300 teeth gleaming in sunlight. Water cascades off its white belly. A burst of spray surrounds the shark. Raw predatory power captured mid-breach.

interactionButtons.label: Show the teeth!
interactionButtons.prompt: The Great White Shark is opening its massive jaws wide, revealing row upon row of 300 razor-sharp serrated teeth arranged in a terrifying conveyor-belt formation, the triangular front teeth gleaming white in the sunlight, its cold black eye staring directly at the viewer through crystal-clear blue water

interactionButtons.label: Breach the surface!
interactionButtons.prompt: The Great White Shark is launching its massive body out of the ocean in a spectacular breach, jaws wide open with 300 teeth gleaming in sunlight, water cascading off its white belly and dark gray-blue back, an explosion of spray surrounding the shark mid-air, raw predatory power frozen at its peak

interactionButtons.label: Circle closer
interactionButtons.prompt: The Great White Shark is circling slowly closer through the clear blue water, its powerful streamlined body turning in a tightening spiral, every scar and scratch visible on its skin, electroreceptor pores dotting its snout, cold focused black eye tracking movement, the water churning gently in its wake

rooms.name: Chromatic Shapeshifter Den
rooms.itemToRemember: Octopus — eight arms with suckers, three hearts, blue blood, can change color and texture instantly, extremely intelligent
rooms.mnemonic: A genius alien with eight suckered arms, three hearts pumping blue blood, that can instantly transform its skin color and texture like a living chameleon — arguably the smartest invertebrate on Earth.
rooms.sceneDescription: A large octopus sits on a colorful coral reef, its eight arms spread dramatically, each one covered in hundreds of visible suckers. The octopus is in the middle of changing color — its left side shows vivid coral-red matching the reef, while its right side shifts through electric blue and purple, with rippling chromatophore patterns visible on its skin like a living light show. Its skin texture is also changing — smooth on one side, bumpy and spiky on the other to match the coral. Two large, intelligent golden eyes stare directly at the camera. One arm reaches toward the viewer, suckers visible in detail. The coral reef around it is vibrant with tropical fish, anemones, and sea fans. Clear turquoise water with dappled sunlight from above. Photorealistic, vivid colors, underwater, cinematic close-up.

odysseyKeyframes.prompt: Large octopus on colorful coral reef, eight arms spread with visible suckers. Changing color — left side coral-red, right side electric blue-purple, chromatophore ripples. Texture shifting smooth to bumpy. Intelligent golden eyes at camera. Vibrant reef, tropical fish. Photorealistic, underwater, cinematic.

The octopus rapidly shifts its entire body color — waves of electric blue, vivid orange, deep purple, and white ripple across its skin in mesmerizing patterns. Its texture transforms from smooth to spiky to coral-like. The chromatophore display is dazzling, like a living kaleidoscope.

The octopus jets backward off the reef, all eight arms trailing behind, suckers flashing. Its body flushes deep red in alarm. An ink cloud billows from its siphon, creating a dark screen. Through the dissipating ink, the octopus vanishes — perfectly camouflaged against a new rock, nearly invisible.

interactionButtons.label: Change colors!
interactionButtons.prompt: The octopus is rapidly shifting its entire body through a dazzling spectrum of colors — waves of electric blue, vivid orange, deep purple, and bright white are rippling across its skin in mesmerizing chromatophore patterns, its texture morphing from smooth to spiky to coral-like, a living kaleidoscope on the vibrant reef

interactionButtons.label: Squirt ink!
interactionButtons.prompt: The octopus is jetting backward off the coral reef, all eight suckered arms trailing behind, its body flushing deep alarm-red as a massive cloud of dark ink billows from its siphon, creating a swirling black smokescreen in the turquoise water, the octopus vanishing into the inky darkness

interactionButtons.label: Reach an arm out
interactionButtons.prompt: The octopus is extending one long arm directly toward the viewer, hundreds of white suckers visible in incredible detail along the underside, the arm curling and probing curiously, its intelligent golden eye staring from behind the outstretched tentacle, chromatophore colors rippling across its skin

rooms.name: Ghost Drift Hall
rooms.itemToRemember: Jellyfish — no brain, no heart, no blood, 95% water, some are immortal (Turritopsis), tentacles deliver painful stings
rooms.mnemonic: A brainless, heartless, bloodless ghost made of 95% water that drifts through the ocean — and one species (Turritopsis) discovered the secret to immortality by turning back into a baby when it gets old.
rooms.sceneDescription: A large moon jellyfish floats in dark deep-blue ocean water, its translucent bell-shaped body glowing with ethereal bioluminescence in pale blue and soft purple. The bell is almost completely transparent — you can see through it to the dark water beyond. Long trailing tentacles hang below, delicate and thread-like, glowing faintly with stinging cells. Inside the transparent body, the simple internal structure is visible — the radial canals and gonads form a four-leaf clover pattern. Several smaller jellyfish of different species float nearby — some pulsing with pink and orange light, others trailing extremely long tentacles. The dark water is filled with tiny particles of marine snow, lit by the jellyfish glow. No visible organs, no brain, no heart — just ethereal glowing water-creatures. Photorealistic, bioluminescent, underwater, cinematic.

odysseyKeyframes.prompt: Large moon jellyfish floating in dark deep-blue water, translucent bell glowing ethereal blue-purple bioluminescence. See-through body, trailing tentacles with stinging cells. Four-leaf clover internal pattern. Smaller jellyfish nearby glowing pink and orange. Marine snow particles. Photorealistic, bioluminescent, cinematic.

The jellyfish pulses its translucent bell — contracting and expanding rhythmically, propelling itself gently through the dark water. The bioluminescent glow intensifies with each pulse, sending waves of blue-purple light through its body. Tentacles drift and trail behind in graceful spirals.

Multiple jellyfish drift together in a mesmerizing swarm, their bioluminescent bodies creating a constellation of glowing blue, purple, pink, and green lights in the dark ocean. The transparent bells pulse at different rhythms. Long tentacles interweave. It's an alien, ethereal, otherworldly ballet of light.

interactionButtons.label: Pulse and glow!
interactionButtons.prompt: The moon jellyfish is pulsing its translucent bell with intensified bioluminescence, each rhythmic contraction sending brilliant waves of blue-purple light radiating through its transparent body, the glow illuminating the dark deep-sea water, long trailing tentacles glowing with ethereal light

interactionButtons.label: Jellyfish swarm!
interactionButtons.prompt: Dozens of bioluminescent jellyfish are drifting together in a mesmerizing swarm, their transparent bells pulsing at different rhythms, creating a constellation of glowing blue, purple, pink, and green lights scattered through the dark ocean like living stars, long tentacles interweaving gracefully

interactionButtons.label: Trail the tentacles
interactionButtons.prompt: The jellyfish is drifting gently through the dark water with its long delicate tentacles trailing behind in graceful spiraling ribbons, each thread glowing faintly with bioluminescent stinging cells, marine snow particles floating past like underwater snowflakes, the ethereal ghostlike creature made of 95 percent water

rooms.name: Ancient Navigator Beach
rooms.itemToRemember: Sea Turtle — can live over 100 years, migrates thousands of miles, returns to the same beach where it was born to lay eggs
rooms.mnemonic: A wise 100-year-old ocean traveler that swims thousands of miles using an invisible map in its head — and always finds its way back to the exact beach where it was born, like a living GPS.
rooms.sceneDescription: A large green sea turtle swims gracefully through crystal-clear tropical water, its flippers extended mid-stroke. The turtle's shell is beautifully patterned with overlapping scutes in shades of olive, brown, and gold. Its wise ancient face shows calm determination — the turtle appears old and experienced. Coral reef below with colorful fish. Shafts of golden sunlight stream down from the surface, creating patterns on the turtle's shell and the sandy bottom. In the background, a tropical beach is visible through the water surface — white sand where the turtle was born and will return. The water is impossibly clear turquoise. Small remora fish ride along on the turtle's shell. Seagrass waves gently on the seafloor. Photorealistic, peaceful, underwater, warm lighting, cinematic wide-angle.

odysseyKeyframes.prompt: Large green sea turtle swimming gracefully through crystal-clear tropical water, flippers extended. Beautiful shell with olive-brown-gold scutes. Wise ancient face. Coral reef below, colorful fish. Golden sunlight shafts. Tropical beach visible through surface. Turquoise water. Remora fish on shell. Photorealistic, cinematic.

The sea turtle glides upward toward the sunlit surface, its powerful flippers pulling it gracefully through the water. Sunlight grows brighter, casting the turtle in golden silhouette. Air bubbles trail from its nostrils. The surface shimmers above like liquid glass.

The sea turtle breaks the ocean surface and takes a breath, its ancient head lifted into warm golden sunset light. The tropical beach stretches in the background — home. The turtle's wet shell glistens in the fading sun. Calm turquoise water surrounds it. A moment of peaceful return after thousands of miles of ocean travel.

interactionButtons.label: Swim to shore!
interactionButtons.prompt: The ancient green sea turtle is swimming powerfully toward a tropical beach visible through the shimmering water surface, its strong flippers pulling it gracefully through turquoise water, golden sunset light growing brighter as it rises, the white sand beach of its birthplace stretching in the warm distance

interactionButtons.label: Ride a current
interactionButtons.prompt: The sea turtle is gliding effortlessly on a warm ocean current, its flippers tucked at its sides, its beautifully patterned olive-brown-gold shell catching dappled sunlight, small remora fish hitching a ride on its back, tropical coral reef passing below in a blur of color

interactionButtons.label: Take a breath
interactionButtons.prompt: The sea turtle is breaking the ocean surface and lifting its ancient wise head into the warm golden sunset light to take a deep breath, its wet shell glistening with water droplets, the calm turquoise ocean stretching to the horizon, a peaceful moment after thousands of miles of ocean migration

rooms.name: Abyss Lantern Trap
rooms.itemToRemember: Anglerfish — deep sea predator, female has a glowing lure on its head to attract prey in total darkness, males are tiny parasites
rooms.mnemonic: A nightmare fish in the pitch-black deep sea that dangles a glowing fishing rod from its forehead to lure prey — and the males are so tiny they permanently fuse to the female's body like living parasites.
rooms.sceneDescription: A female anglerfish hovers in the pitch-black deep ocean, her enormous gaping mouth filled with long, needle-sharp translucent teeth pointing in every direction. Her bioluminescent lure — the esca — dangles from a fleshy rod (illicium) protruding from her forehead, glowing an eerie blue-green that illuminates her horrifying face in the darkness. Her body is dark brown-black, round and bloated, with rough bumpy skin. Her small beady eyes reflect the lure's light. A tiny parasitic male — barely visible — is fused to her belly, having permanently attached. The surrounding water is completely black except for the anglerfish's lure glow, with tiny bioluminescent particles floating in the water like stars. The scene is terrifying and fascinating. Photorealistic, dark, bioluminescent, deep sea, cinematic close-up.

odysseyKeyframes.prompt: Female anglerfish in pitch-black deep ocean. Enormous gaping mouth with needle-sharp translucent teeth. Bioluminescent blue-green lure dangling from forehead rod, illuminating horrifying face. Dark bloated body, rough skin. Tiny parasitic male fused to belly. Black water, bioluminescent particles. Photorealistic, cinematic.

The anglerfish's glowing lure swings gently in the dark water, casting eerie blue-green light across her nightmarish face. A small deep-sea fish approaches, drawn to the light. The anglerfish remains perfectly still, mouth open, needle teeth ready. The trap is set in the absolute darkness.

The anglerfish strikes with blinding speed — her enormous mouth snaps open impossibly wide and engulfs the prey fish in one gulp. Her needle teeth interlock like a cage. The lure flickers with the sudden movement. The dark water swirls. Then silence returns to the abyss, the lure glowing steadily again.

interactionButtons.label: Dangle the lure!
interactionButtons.prompt: The anglerfish's bioluminescent lure is swinging gently through the pitch-black deep sea, casting an eerie blue-green glow across her nightmarish face full of needle-sharp translucent teeth, the fleshy rod on her forehead waving the glowing esca back and forth, drawing a small curious fish closer to the trap

interactionButtons.label: Snap the jaws!
interactionButtons.prompt: The anglerfish is snapping her enormous mouth open impossibly wide, needle-sharp teeth interlocking like a cage, lunging forward in the pitch darkness to engulf prey in one lightning-fast gulp, her bioluminescent lure flickering wildly with the sudden violent movement, the dark water swirling

interactionButtons.label: Light up the dark
interactionButtons.prompt: The anglerfish's bioluminescent lure is glowing with intensified blue-green light, illuminating a wider circle of the pitch-black abyss, revealing her horrifying bloated dark body, needle teeth, beady eyes, and the tiny parasitic male fused to her belly, bioluminescent particles floating like stars around her
